title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Style of Litigation Documents for Summary Procedure in Civil Cases (Trial Implementation)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Circular on Issuing the Forms of Litigation Documents for Simple Civil Procedure (Trial Implementation)

Fa Fa [2003] No. 21

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

To coordinate with the implementation of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Trying Civil Cases under Simple Procedure, and to further standardize the activities of trying civil cases under simple procedure, upon the decision of the 1280th meeting of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, the First Civil Division of the Supreme People's Court has formulated and issued the Forms of Litigation Documents for Simple Civil Procedure (Trial Implementation) (hereinafter referred to as the "Forms"). The Forms are hereby issued to you, and basic people's courts shall refer to them and implement them in their trial work. If any issues arise during the trial implementation of the Forms, please promptly report them to the First Civil Division of this Court.

December 19, 2003

Forms of Litigation Documents for Simple Civil Procedure (Trial Implementation)

Table of Contents

1. Oral Complaint Registration Form
2. Confirmation of Service Address for the Parties
3. Form for Application for Approval of Conversion to Ordinary Procedure
4. Notice of Conversion of Procedure (I) (To be used when the People's Court decides)
5. Notice of Conversion of Procedure (II) (To be used upon application by a party)
6. Summons
7. Acknowledgment of Service
8. Mediation Agreement
9. Notice for Receiving Judgment Documents
10. Civil Mediation Document (I) (Mediation conducted by the People's Court during the trial process)
11. Civil Mediation Document (II) (Parties request confirmation of a settlement agreement)
12. Civil Mediation Document (III) (Mediation conducted by the People's Court under the pre-mediation procedure)
13. Civil Judgment (I) (The defendant admits all of the plaintiff's claims)
14. Civil Judgment (II) (The parties have no dispute over the facts of the case)
15. Civil Judgment (III) (The defendant has a partial dispute over the facts and claims alleged by the plaintiff)
16. Civil Judgment (IV) (The parties have significant disputes over the facts of the case)

Form 1

_____ People's Court

Oral Complaint Registration Form

Note:

1. This form is to be used when the People's Court records an oral complaint by a natural person.
2. In the "Plaintiff" and "Defendant" boxes, the name, gender, date of birth, ethnicity, place of origin, and work unit shall be stated. If the domicile and service address are the same, "same as above" may be noted in the blank space for the service address. If the defendant is a legal person or other organization, its name, domicile, service address, and telephone number shall be stated.
3. If there are two or more plaintiffs or defendants, or if there is a third party in the case, the information may be filled in the reserved blank spaces.
4. The People's Court shall inform the defendant of the contents of the Oral Complaint Registration Form orally or in writing. If the defendant requests to copy or extract it, permission shall be granted.
5. This form may be filled out with a pen or brush, or by computer printing.

Form 2

_____ People's Court

Confirmation of Service Address for the Parties

Note:

1. This form is to be used for all cases subject to civil simple procedure.
2. Before filling out this form, the party shall carefully read the written notification of the People's Court in the first box regarding the party's completion of the Confirmation of Service Address; if the party has difficulty reading, court staff shall inform them orally.
3. The service address of the party in this form shall be filled in by the party themselves or their agent; if the party is unable to write due to limited education and has no agent, they may dictate to court staff who will fill it in on their behalf, and after being read aloud to ensure accuracy by two or more court staff members, the party shall sign or affix their fingerprint to confirm.
4. The party's telephone numbers shall include office telephone, home telephone, and mobile telephone.
5. If the party refuses to provide their service address, it shall be noted in the "Remarks" box.

Form 3

_____ People's Court

Form for Examination and Approval of Application for Conversion to Ordinary Procedure

Note:

1. This form is to be used when the People's Court, during the trial of a civil case under simple procedure, deems it necessary to convert to ordinary procedure.
2. If during the trial the judge finds the case complex and needs to convert to ordinary procedure, they shall promptly fill out this form before the expiration of the trial period and submit it for approval.

Form 4

_____ People's Court

Notice of Conversion of Procedure (I)

(  ) ________ Zi No. _____

To: __________:

In the dispute between you (your entity) and __________, during the trial under simple procedure, this Court has found that __________. Pursuant to Article 170 of the Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Articles 3 and 26 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Trying Civil Cases under Simple Procedure, it is decided to convert this case to ordinary procedure, with __________ presiding as the presiding judge, and __________ and __________ forming a collegial panel to try the case.

The period for submitting evidence in this case is extended to __________ (year) __________ (month) __________ (day). Failure to submit evidence within the extended period shall be deemed as waiver of the right to submit evidence.

__________ (year) __________ (month) __________ (day)

(Court Seal)

Note:

1. This form is to be used when the People's Court, during the trial of a case under simple procedure, finds the facts complex and decides to convert to ordinary procedure.
2. This notice shall be served to both parties.

Form 5

_____ People's Court

Notice of Conversion of Procedure (II)

(  ) ________ Zi No. _____

To: __________:

In the dispute between you (your entity) and __________, during the trial under simple procedure, __________ raised an objection to this Court's application of simple procedure on the ground that __________. Upon examination, the objection is sustained. Pursuant to Article 170 of the Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Articles 3 and 13 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Trying Civil Cases under Simple Procedure, it is decided to convert this case to ordinary procedure, with __________ presiding as the presiding judge, and __________ and __________ forming a collegial panel to try the case.

The period for submitting evidence in this case is extended to __________ (year) __________ (month) __________ (day). Failure to submit evidence within the extended period shall be deemed as waiver of the right to submit evidence.

__________ (year) __________ (month) __________ (day)

(Court Seal)

Note:

1. This form is to be used when, during the trial of a case under simple procedure, a party raises an objection to the People's Court's application of simple procedure and the objection is found to be sustained upon examination.
2. This notice shall be served to both parties.

Form 6

_____ People's Court

Summons

Note:

1. This form is to be used when the People's Court summons a party.
2. The seal of the People's Court shall be affixed at the center of the header.
3. This summons is to be made in duplicate: one copy for the case file, and one copy for service on the party.

Form 7

_____ People's Court

Acknowledgment of Service

Note:

1. This form is to be used when the People's Court serves litigation documents under simple procedure.
2. If multiple litigation documents are served simultaneously, the names and number of copies of the documents may be separately filled in the "Documents Served" column.
3. The seal of the People's Court shall be affixed at the center of the header.
4. If a party comes to the People's Court to receive litigation documents, "_____ People's Court" may be filled in the "Service Address" column.
5. In the case of service by leaving the document at the place of service (留置送达), the circumstances shall be recorded in the "Remarks" column.

Note:

1. This form is to be used when a first-instance court mediates a civil case under simple procedure.
2. The content of this mediation agreement shall be clear, specific, and easy to enforce.
3. If a party requests to extract or copy this mediation agreement, permission shall be granted.
4. If a party requests to have the Civil Mediation Document served by mail, the People's Court may, within ten days from the day after the parties reach the mediation agreement, send the Civil Mediation Document to each party at the service address provided by the parties before the hearing.

Form 9

_____ People's Court

Notice for Receiving Judgment Documents

(  ) ________ Min Zi No. _____

To: __________:

The case of __________ v. __________ accepted by this Court was heard on __________ (year) __________ (month) __________ (day). The time and related matters for receiving the Civil __________ Document are hereby notified in writing as follows:

I. You (your entity) must bring this notice to Room __________ of the People's Court to receive the Civil __________ Document between __________ (year) __________ (month) __________ (day) and __________ (year) __________ (month) __________ (day).

II. If the People's Court has informed the parties of the period and place for receiving the judgment document, the day on which the party receives the judgment document within the specified period shall be deemed the date of service; if the party fails to receive the document within the specified period, the day on which the specified period for receiving the judgment document expires shall be deemed the date of service, and the party's appeal period shall begin from the day following the expiration of the period specified by the People's Court for receiving the judgment document.

III. If, due to inconvenient transportation or other reasons, a party requests that the judgment document be served by mail, the party shall inform the People's Court when signing this notice. The People's Court shall send the document by mail to the service address and recipient confirmed and provided by the party. In the case of service by mail, the party's appeal period shall begin from the day following the date indicated on the mail receipt showing receipt or return.

__________ (year) __________ (month) __________ (day)

(Court Seal)

Note:

This form is to be used when the People's Court notifies a party to receive a judgment document.

3. After the Court Clerk verifies that the Civil Mediation Document is correct, the seal "This copy has been verified to be identical with the original" shall be affixed.

Form 13

Civil Judgment

(The defendant admits all of the plaintiff's claims)

(state that the parties and their litigation representatives, etc.) appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. The trial of this case has now been concluded.

(Court Seal)

Note:

1. This judgment form is to be used when the People's Court makes a decision on the substantive issues of the case where the defendant admits all of the plaintiff's claims.
2. This judgment form consists of five parts: the caption, facts, reasoning, judgment result, and closing.
3. The caption includes the name of the court, type of document, case number, litigation participants and their basic information, and the origin of the case, trial organization, and method of trial.
4. The facts part includes the facts claimed by the plaintiff and the claims, and the fact that the defendant admits all of the plaintiff's claims.
5. The reasoning part refers to the laws on which the judgment is based.
6. The judgment result is the decision on the substantive issues of the case. The judgment result shall be clear, specific, and complete.
7. After the Court Clerk verifies that the Civil Judgment is correct, the seal "This copy has been verified to be identical with the original" shall be affixed.

Note:

1. This judgment form is to be used by the People's Court when making a decision on the substantive issues of a case where the parties have no dispute over the facts of the case.

2. This judgment form consists of five parts: the heading, facts, reasoning, judgment result, and closing.

3. The heading includes the name of the court, the type of document, the case number, the participants in the litigation and their basic information, as well as the origin of the case, the adjudication panel, and the method of trial.

4. The facts part includes the plaintiff's claims, facts and reasons, and the defendant's admission of the facts claimed by the plaintiff.

5. The reasoning part includes the reasons for the judgment and the laws on which the judgment is based.

6. The judgment result is the decision on the substantive issues of the case. The judgment result shall be clear, specific, and complete.

7. After the civil judgment has been verified by the clerk as correct, it shall be affixed with a seal stating "This copy has been verified against the original."
